<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data (carbonyl ~169 ppm, aromatic carbons ~126‑132 ppm, a benzylic CH₂ around 43 ppm, and a methyl carbon around 26 ppm), the most consistent structure is benzyl acetate (phenylmethyl acetate). Its SMILES is "CC(=O)OCc1ccccc1".</thought>
<final_answer>CC(=O)OCc1ccccc1</final_answer>
